title: Bounded overlap, explicit revocation, cert rotation, expiry (VC-201-077)
goal: VC-201-077 refuted: evaluate_rekey_policy is a pure advisory function with no production callers and no overlap/revocation/certificate surface; the rotated-out cluster.key.prev persists forever — overlap is unbounded; keys carry no expiry — a stale staged key activates on fingerprint match alone; a torn staged file wedges activation until outside repair; no transport-certificate rotation exists anywhere. Evidence: crates/susi-config/src/tests/vc_201_077_mastery.rs.
